home.hero.title: Dukaan ka hisaab, ab phone pe.
home.hero.sub: Billing, stock and udhaar in one simple app for kirana stores, supermarkets and small shops across India. Make your first bill in under three minutes. No training, no extra hardware.
features.title: Everything the counter needs. Nothing it doesn’t.
features.sub: Built around how shopkeepers actually work: quick at the till, clear at the end of the day.

how.s2.title: Add your stock

how.s3.title: Make your first bill

faq.meta.title: FAQ | Nexper
faq.meta.description: Answers to common questions about Nexper: setup, hardware, udhaar, GST, pricing and your data.
faq.title: Questions shopkeepers ask
faq.intro: Quick answers about setting up and using Nexper. Can’t find yours? Contact us.
faq.q1: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a1: No. Nexper opens in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer. On your phone you can add it to the home screen and it opens like an app.
faq.a2: No. Your phone camera scans barcodes. If you already have a printer you can print bills, but most shops just send the bill on WhatsApp.
faq.q3: What happens when the internet goes down?
faq.a3: New bills and stock changes are saved on your phone and sent automatically when you are back online. Reports need a connection.
faq.a4: Yes. Billing, stock, udhaar, day close, expenses, cashbook and the GST summary are free for one shop, with you plus one staff login. During early access every Pro feature is free too.
faq.a5: Yes. Each helper gets a staff code and PIN, and you decide which screens they can see. The limits are checked on our server, not just hidden in the app.
faq.a6: You get a rate-wise GST summary for any month and a GSTR-1 export for the GST Offline Tool. It is a helper, not a filing service, so please check returns with your accountant.
faq.a7: Each shop’s data is kept separate by access rules in the database, and only the people you add can see it. Read our privacy policy for details.
